faqs.question: What is a normal adult weight range for a British Shorthair?
faqs.answer: This breed record lists 9-17 lb (4-8 kg). Your veterinarian sets the target for the individual using body condition, not only the breed average.

faqs.question: Which health issues should I watch for in a senior British Shorthair?
faqs.answer: This stage guide highlights Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) risk; Obesity; Dental disease. Use the linked symptom pages for red flags, then contact your clinic.

faqs.question: How often should I weigh my British Shorthair at this stage?
faqs.answer: At least every 30 days for a senior British Shorthair, sooner if appetite, thirst, or mobility changes.
